do_not_cross_barrier.name: Do Not Cross — Barrier
do_not_cross_barrier.description: Two weighted posts with a tape strung between them at hip height, reading DO NOT CROSS. The line as OBSTACLE: a body would have to duck under it. Pairs with walk_this_line_marking, the floor half of the same asset — which does not repeat the prohibition but reverses it, reading WALK THIS LINE.

measurements.source: authored glTF, read from accessor bounds

dev_themes: the line as instrument of exclusion
do_not_cross_barrier.qfep_connection: Point_Lines argues that measure is also violence — what does not fit the grid is remainder, error, erased. This and its companion are that argument as furniture, standing in PERPENDICULAR relations to one line: the tape forbids crossing it, the paint commands following it.
do_not_cross_barrier.note: Instantiates res://commons/models/do_not_cross_line.glb and keeps post_left, post_right, barrier_tape and printed_legend; the floor assembly belongs to its companion. The two artifacts share ONE asset and draw DISJOINT subtrees — this is not the one-scene-many-names pattern, which is two tokens running one identical script. The asset is authored as one file because the barrier and the marking are dimensioned against each other: the posts stand at x = +/-1.6 and the floor legend lies 1.18 m in front of them.
